# YouTube Video Update with CIFRIA Attribution & Playlist Management Plan
## Use Case: Update Video Content, Preserve Thumbnails, Organize by Parasha Playlists

**Created**: 2026-03-05
**Updated**: 2026-03-05
**Status**: Planning
**Generated by**: Claude Sonnet 4.5

---

## 1. Overview

This plan outlines the implementation of YouTube video content updates, metadata management, and playlist organization for Torah sync videos, with proper attribution to CIFRIA. The key requirements are to:
1. **Replace video content while preserving existing thumbnails** from the source channel
2. **Organize videos into playlists**: Each parasha has its own playlist containing its 7 aliyot

### 1.1 Goals

- **Video Replacement**: Update existing YouTube videos with newly generated synchronized videos
- **Thumbnail Preservation**: Download and preserve existing thumbnails from source channel
- **Metadata Management**: Update video metadata with CIFRIA attribution
- **Playlist Organization**: Each parasha in its own playlist containing 7 aliyot
- **Source Channel**: Reuse thumbnails from https://www.youtube.com/@קריאהבתורהמפייוסףבודנהיימר
- **Automation**: Seamless batch processing of video updates

### 1.2 Key Requirements

1. YouTube API v3 integration for video updates and metadata management
2. Download existing thumbnails before video update
3. Re-upload preserved thumbnails after video replacement
4. CIFRIA attribution in title, description, and tags
5. **Playlist management**: Create one playlist per parasha with 7 aliyot videos
6. Configuration-driven metadata templates
7. Video-to-video mapping (old video ID → new video content)
8. OAuth2 authentication for YouTube API

## 2. Architecture

### 2.1 New Components

```
src/
├── models/
│   ├── youtube_metadata.py      # YouTube metadata model
│   ├── youtube_video.py         # YouTube video model
│   ├── youtube_playlist.py      # YouTube playlist model
│   └── video_mapping.py         # Old video → new content mapping
├── services/
│   ├── youtube/
│   │   ├── auth.py              # OAuth2 authentication
│   │   ├── api_client.py        # YouTube Data API v3 wrapper
│   │   ├── metadata_builder.py  # Metadata construction with CIFRIA
│   │   ├── thumbnail_manager.py # Download/preserve/restore thumbnails
│   │   ├── video_updater.py     # Video content replacement
│   │   ├── playlist_manager.py  # Playlist creation and management
│   │   └── channel_scanner.py   # List videos from source channel
└── cli/
    └── youtube_commands.py      # CLI commands for YouTube operations

config/
├── youtube_templates.toml       # Metadata templates with CIFRIA attribution
├── video_mappings.json          # Video ID mappings (old → new)
└── parasha_playlists.json       # Parasha → playlist mappings

data/
├── thumbnails/                  # Downloaded thumbnail cache
│   ├── {video_id}_original.jpg
│   └── metadata.json
└── playlists/                   # Playlist metadata cache
    └── parasha_playlists.json
```

### 2.2 Data Flow

```
1. Scan Source Channel
   ↓
2. List All Videos with Metadata
   ↓
3. Download Existing Thumbnails
   ↓
4. Generate Video Mapping (old video → new local video)
   ↓
5. Create/Update Playlists (one per parasha)
   ↓
6. Update Video Content (upload new video)
   ↓
7. Add Video to Appropriate Parasha Playlist
   ↓
8. Restore Original Thumbnail
   ↓
9. Update Metadata with CIFRIA Attribution
   ↓
10. Verify Update Success
```

```python
# Generated by Claude Code
"""YouTube video model with metadata and thumbnail tracking."""

from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime

class YouTubeVideo(BaseModel):
    """YouTube video with metadata and thumbnail information.

    Attributes:
        video_id: YouTube video ID
        title: Current video title
        description: Current video description
        thumbnail_url: URL of current thumbnail (default or maxres)
        thumbnail_local_path: Local cached thumbnail path
        published_at: Video publication date
        duration: Video duration in ISO 8601 format
        view_count: Current view count
        privacy_status: Privacy level
    """

    video_id: str = Field(..., description="YouTube video ID")
    title: str = Field(..., description="Video title")
    description: str = Field("", description="Video description")
    thumbnail_url: str = Field(..., description="Thumbnail URL")
    thumbnail_local_path: Path | None = Field(
        None,
        description="Local cached thumbnail"
    )
    published_at: datetime | None = Field(None, description="Publication date")
    duration: str | None = Field(None, description="Video duration")
    view_count: int = Field(0, description="View count")
    privacy_status: str = Field("unlisted", description="Privacy status")

    def has_cached_thumbnail(self) -> bool:
        """Check if thumbnail is cached locally."""
        return (
            self.thumbnail_local_path is not None
            and self.thumbnail_local_path.exists()
        )
```

### 3.3 YouTubeMetadata Model

```python
# Generated by Claude Code
"""YouTube metadata model with CIFRIA attribution."""

from pydantic import BaseModel, Field, field_validator

class YouTubeMetadata(BaseModel):
    """YouTube video metadata with CIFRIA attribution.

    Attributes:
        video_id: YouTube video ID (if already uploaded)
        title: Video title (max 100 chars)
        description: Video description (max 5000 chars)
        tags: List of tags (max 500 chars total)
        category_id: YouTube category ID (default: 27 = Education)
        default_language: Video language (default: "he" for Hebrew)
        default_audio_language: Audio language (default: "he")
        privacy_status: Privacy level ("private", "unlisted", "public")
        cifria_attribution: CIFRIA attribution text
    """

    video_id: str | None = Field(None, description="YouTube video ID")
    title: str = Field(..., max_length=100, description="Video title")
    description: str = Field(..., max_length=5000, description="Video description")
    tags: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list, description="Video tags")
    category_id: str = Field("27", description="YouTube category (27=Education)")
    default_language: str = Field("he", description="Video language")
    default_audio_language: str = Field("he", description="Audio language")
    privacy_status: str = Field("unlisted", description="Privacy status")
    cifria_attribution: str = Field(
        default="Source materials courtesy of CIFRIA",
        description="CIFRIA attribution text"
    )

    @field_validator("tags")
    @classmethod
    def validate_tags(cls, v: list[str]) -> list[str]:
        """Validate total tag length doesn't exceed 500 characters."""
        total_length = sum(len(tag) for tag in v)
        if total_length > 500:
            raise ValueError(f"Total tags length {total_length} exceeds 500 chars")
        return v

    @field_validator("privacy_status")
    @classmethod
    def validate_privacy(cls, v: str) -> str:
        """Validate privacy status."""
        if v not in {"private", "unlisted", "public"}:
            raise ValueError(f"Invalid privacy status: {v}")
        return v
```

```python
# Generated by Claude Code
"""YouTube playlist model for organizing videos by parasha."""

from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from datetime import datetime

class YouTubePlaylist(BaseModel):
    """YouTube playlist representing a parasha with its aliyot.

    Attributes:
        playlist_id: YouTube playlist ID (if already created)
        parasha_name: Name of the parasha (Hebrew)
        title: Playlist title
        description: Playlist description
        privacy_status: Privacy level ("private", "unlisted", "public")
        video_ids: List of video IDs in the playlist (ordered by aliyah)
        aliyah_count: Expected number of aliyot (default: 7)
        created_at: When playlist was created
        updated_at: Last update time
    """

    playlist_id: str | None = Field(None, description="YouTube playlist ID")
    parasha_name: str = Field(..., description="Parasha name (Hebrew)")
    title: str = Field(..., max_length=150, description="Playlist title")
    description: str = Field("", max_length=5000, description="Playlist description")
    privacy_status: str = Field("unlisted", description="Privacy status")
    video_ids: list[str] = Field(
        default_factory=list,
        description="Video IDs in order (by aliyah)"
    )
    aliyah_count: int = Field(7, description="Expected number of aliyot")
    created_at: datetime | None = Field(None, description="Creation timestamp")
    updated_at: datetime | None = Field(None, description="Last update timestamp")

    def is_complete(self) -> bool:
        """Check if playlist has all expected aliyot."""
        return len(self.video_ids) == self.aliyah_count

    def get_aliyah_position(self, aliyah_name: str) -> int:
        """Get position for an aliyah in the playlist.

        Args:
            aliyah_name: Aliyah name (ראשון, שני, etc.)

        Returns:
            Zero-based position in playlist
        """
        aliyah_order = {
            'ראשון': 0,
            'שני': 1,
            'שלישי': 2,
            'רביעי': 3,
            'חמישי': 4,
            'ששי': 5,
            'שביעי': 6,
        }
        return aliyah_order.get(aliyah_name, 0)
```

## 4. YouTube Services

### 4.1 Channel Scanner Service

```python
# src/services/youtube/channel_scanner.py
# Generated by Claude Code
"""YouTube channel scanner to list all videos."""

from googleapiclient.errors import HttpError
import logging

from src.services.youtube.auth import YouTubeAuth
from src.models.youtube_video import YouTubeVideo

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

class ChannelScanner:
    """Scans YouTube channel and lists all videos with metadata."""

    def __init__(self, auth: YouTubeAuth):
        """Initialize channel scanner.

        Args:
            auth: YouTube authentication service
        """
        self.auth = auth
        self._youtube = None

    @property
    def youtube(self):
        """Lazy-load YouTube API service."""
        if not self._youtube:
            from googleapiclient.discovery import build
            creds = self.auth.get_credentials()
            self._youtube = build('youtube', 'v3', credentials=creds)
        return self._youtube

    def get_channel_id_from_handle(self, handle: str) -> str:
        """Get channel ID from custom handle/username.

        Args:
            handle: Channel handle (e.g., "@קריאהבתורהמפייוסףבודנהיימר")

        Returns:
            Channel ID

        Raises:
            ValueError: If channel not found
        """
        logger.debug(f"{handle=}")

        # Remove @ prefix if present
        handle = handle.lstrip('@')

        try:
            # Search for channel by handle
            response = self.youtube.channels().list(
                part='id',
                forHandle=handle
            ).execute()

            if 'items' not in response or not response['items']:
                raise ValueError(f"Channel not found: {handle}")

            channel_id = response['items'][0]['id']
            logger.info(f"Found channel ID: {channel_id}")
            return channel_id

        except HttpError as e:
            logger.error(f"Failed to get channel ID: {e}")
            raise

    def list_all_videos(
        self,
        channel_id: str,
        max_results: int = 50
    ) -> list[YouTubeVideo]:
        """List all videos from a channel.

        Args:
            channel_id: YouTube channel ID
            max_results: Maximum videos per page (max 50)

        Returns:
            List of YouTubeVideo objects

        Raises:
            HttpError: If API request fails
        """
        logger.info(f"Listing videos from channel: {channel_id}")

        videos = []
        next_page_token = None

        while True:
            try:
                # Get channel uploads playlist
                response = self.youtube.channels().list(
                    part='contentDetails',
                    id=channel_id
                ).execute()

                if 'items' not in response or not response['items']:
                    logger.warning(f"Channel not found: {channel_id}")
                    break

                uploads_playlist_id = response['items'][0]['contentDetails'][
                    'relatedPlaylists'
                ]['uploads']

                # Get videos from uploads playlist
                playlist_response = self.youtube.playlistItems().list(
                    part='snippet,contentDetails',
                    playlistId=uploads_playlist_id,
                    maxResults=max_results,
                    pageToken=next_page_token
                ).execute()

                # Extract video details
                for item in playlist_response.get('items', []):
                    video_id = item['contentDetails']['videoId']
                    snippet = item['snippet']

                    # Get best thumbnail URL (maxres > high > default)
                    thumbnails = snippet.get('thumbnails', {})
                    thumbnail_url = (
                        thumbnails.get('maxres', {}).get('url')
                        or thumbnails.get('high', {}).get('url')
                        or thumbnails.get('default', {}).get('url')
                    )

                    video = YouTubeVideo(
                        video_id=video_id,
                        title=snippet.get('title', ''),
                        description=snippet.get('description', ''),
                        thumbnail_url=thumbnail_url,
                        published_at=snippet.get('publishedAt'),
                        privacy_status=snippet.get('privacyStatus', 'unlisted')
                    )

                    videos.append(video)

                logger.debug(f"Found {len(playlist_response.get('items', []))} videos")

                # Check for more pages
                next_page_token = playlist_response.get('nextPageToken')
                if not next_page_token:
                    break

            except HttpError as e:
                logger.error(f"Failed to list videos: {e}")
                raise

        logger.info(f"Total videos found: {len(videos)}")
        return videos
```

### 4.2 Thumbnail Manager Service

```python
# src/services/youtube/thumbnail_manager.py
# Generated by Claude Code
"""Thumbnail download, preservation, and restoration service."""

from pathlib import Path
import httpx
import logging
import json
from datetime import datetime

from src.models.youtube_video import YouTubeVideo

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

class ThumbnailManager:
    """Manages thumbnail download, caching, and restoration."""

    def __init__(self, cache_dir: Path = Path("data/thumbnails")):
        """Initialize thumbnail manager.

        Args:
            cache_dir: Directory to cache downloaded thumbnails
        """
        self.cache_dir = cache_dir
        self.cache_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        self.metadata_file = self.cache_dir / "metadata.json"
        self._load_metadata()

    def _load_metadata(self) -> None:
        """Load thumbnail metadata from cache."""
        if self.metadata_file.exists():
            with open(self.metadata_file) as f:
                self.metadata = json.load(f)
        else:
            self.metadata = {}

    def _save_metadata(self) -> None:
        """Save thumbnail metadata to cache."""
        with open(self.metadata_file, 'w') as f:
            json.dump(self.metadata, f, indent=2, default=str)

    def download_thumbnail(self, video: YouTubeVideo) -> Path:
        """Download and cache thumbnail for a video.

        Args:
            video: YouTube video with thumbnail URL

        Returns:
            Path to cached thumbnail

        Raises:
            httpx.HTTPError: If download fails
        """
        logger.info(f"Downloading thumbnail for video: {video.video_id}")

        # Check if already cached
        cached_path = self.cache_dir / f"{video.video_id}_original.jpg"
        if cached_path.exists():
            logger.debug(f"Thumbnail already cached: {cached_path}")
            video.thumbnail_local_path = cached_path
            return cached_path

        # Download thumbnail
        try:
            response = httpx.get(video.thumbnail_url, timeout=30.0)
            response.raise_for_status()

            # Save to cache
            with open(cached_path, 'wb') as f:
                f.write(response.content)

            # Update metadata
            self.metadata[video.video_id] = {
                'original_url': video.thumbnail_url,
                'cached_path': str(cached_path),
                'downloaded_at': datetime.utcnow().isoformat(),
                'title': video.title
            }
            self._save_metadata()

            video.thumbnail_local_path = cached_path
            logger.info(f"Thumbnail cached: {cached_path}")
            return cached_path

        except httpx.HTTPError as e:
            logger.error(f"Failed to download thumbnail: {e}")
            raise

    def download_all_thumbnails(
        self,
        videos: list[YouTubeVideo]
    ) -> dict[str, Path]:
        """Download thumbnails for all videos in batch.

        Args:
            videos: List of YouTube videos

        Returns:
            Dictionary mapping video_id to cached thumbnail path
        """
        logger.info(f"Downloading {len(videos)} thumbnails")

        results = {}
        for video in videos:
            try:
                thumbnail_path = self.download_thumbnail(video)
                results[video.video_id] = thumbnail_path
            except Exception as e:
                logger.warning(
                    f"Failed to download thumbnail for {video.video_id}: {e}"
                )
                continue

        logger.info(f"Successfully downloaded {len(results)} thumbnails")
        return results

    def get_cached_thumbnail(self, video_id: str) -> Path | None:
        """Get cached thumbnail path for a video.

        Args:
            video_id: YouTube video ID

        Returns:
            Path to cached thumbnail or None if not cached
        """
        cached_path = self.cache_dir / f"{video_id}_original.jpg"
        if cached_path.exists():
            return cached_path
        return None
```

### 4.3 Playlist Manager Service

```python
# src/services/youtube/playlist_manager.py
# Generated by Claude Code
"""YouTube playlist creation and management service."""

from pathlib import Path
from googleapiclient.discovery import build
from googleapiclient.errors import HttpError
import json
import logging
from datetime import datetime

from src.services.youtube.auth import YouTubeAuth
from src.models.youtube_playlist import YouTubePlaylist

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

class PlaylistManager:
    """Manages YouTube playlists for organizing videos by parasha."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        auth: YouTubeAuth,
        cache_dir: Path = Path("data/playlists")
    ):
        """Initialize playlist manager.

        Args:
            auth: YouTube authentication service
            cache_dir: Directory to cache playlist metadata
        """
        self.auth = auth
        self.cache_dir = cache_dir
        self.cache_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        self.cache_file = self.cache_dir / "parasha_playlists.json"
        self._youtube = None
        self._load_cache()

    @property
    def youtube(self):
        """Lazy-load YouTube API service."""
        if not self._youtube:
            creds = self.auth.get_credentials()
            self._youtube = build('youtube', 'v3', credentials=creds)
        return self._youtube

    def _load_cache(self) -> None:
        """Load playlist cache from file."""
        if self.cache_file.exists():
            with open(self.cache_file, encoding='utf-8') as f:
                self.cache = json.load(f)
        else:
            self.cache = {}

    def _save_cache(self) -> None:
        """Save playlist cache to file."""
        with open(self.cache_file, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
            json.dump(self.cache, f, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False, default=str)

    def create_playlist(
        self,
        parasha_name: str,
        tradition: str = "Ashkenaz"
    ) -> YouTubePlaylist:
        """Create a new playlist for a parasha.

        Args:
            parasha_name: Name of parasha (Hebrew)
            tradition: Reading tradition

        Returns:
            Created playlist

        Raises:
            HttpError: If playlist creation fails
        """
        logger.info(f"Creating playlist for: {parasha_name}")

        # Build playlist metadata
        title = f"{parasha_name} - {tradition} | CIFRIA"
        description = f"""
Torah readings for {parasha_name} ({tradition} tradition)

Contains all 7 aliyot with synchronized Hebrew text and audio.

Source materials courtesy of CIFRIA
        """.strip()

        # Create playlist via API
        try:
            request_body = {
                'snippet': {
                    'title': title,
                    'description': description,
                    'defaultLanguage': 'he',
                },
                'status': {
                    'privacyStatus': 'unlisted'
                }
            }

            response = self.youtube.playlists().insert(
                part='snippet,status',
                body=request_body
            ).execute()

            playlist_id = response['id']
            logger.info(f"Playlist created: {playlist_id}")

            # Create playlist model
            playlist = YouTubePlaylist(
                playlist_id=playlist_id,
                parasha_name=parasha_name,
                title=title,
                description=description,
                privacy_status='unlisted',
                created_at=datetime.utcnow(),
                updated_at=datetime.utcnow()
            )

            # Cache playlist
            self.cache[parasha_name] = {
                'playlist_id': playlist_id,
                'title': title,
                'created_at': playlist.created_at.isoformat(),
                'tradition': tradition
            }
            self._save_cache()

            return playlist

        except HttpError as e:
            logger.error(f"Failed to create playlist: {e}")
            raise

    def get_or_create_playlist(
        self,
        parasha_name: str,
        tradition: str = "Ashkenaz"
    ) -> YouTubePlaylist:
        """Get existing playlist or create new one.

        Args:
            parasha_name: Name of parasha
            tradition: Reading tradition

        Returns:
            Playlist (existing or newly created)
        """
        # Check cache first
        if parasha_name in self.cache:
            playlist_id = self.cache[parasha_name]['playlist_id']
            logger.debug(f"Found cached playlist: {playlist_id}")

            # Fetch current playlist details
            try:
                playlist = self.get_playlist(playlist_id)
                return playlist
            except HttpError as e:
                logger.warning(
                    f"Cached playlist not found, creating new one: {e}"
                )

        # Create new playlist
        return self.create_playlist(parasha_name, tradition)

    def get_playlist(self, playlist_id: str) -> YouTubePlaylist:
        """Fetch playlist details from YouTube.

        Args:
            playlist_id: YouTube playlist ID

        Returns:
            Playlist model

        Raises:
            HttpError: If API request fails
        """
        logger.debug(f"Fetching playlist: {playlist_id}")

        try:
            response = self.youtube.playlists().list(
                part='snippet,status,contentDetails',
                id=playlist_id
            ).execute()

            if 'items' not in response or not response['items']:
                raise ValueError(f"Playlist not found: {playlist_id}")

            item = response['items'][0]
            snippet = item['snippet']

            # Get video IDs in playlist
            video_ids = self._get_playlist_video_ids(playlist_id)

            playlist = YouTubePlaylist(
                playlist_id=playlist_id,
                parasha_name=snippet.get('title', '').split(' - ')[0],
                title=snippet['title'],
                description=snippet.get('description', ''),
                privacy_status=item['status']['privacyStatus'],
                video_ids=video_ids,
                updated_at=datetime.utcnow()
            )

            return playlist

        except HttpError as e:
            logger.error(f"Failed to fetch playlist: {e}")
            raise

    def _get_playlist_video_ids(self, playlist_id: str) -> list[str]:
        """Get list of video IDs in a playlist.

        Args:
            playlist_id: YouTube playlist ID

        Returns:
            List of video IDs in order
        """
        video_ids = []
        next_page_token = None

        while True:
            try:
                response = self.youtube.playlistItems().list(
                    part='contentDetails',
                    playlistId=playlist_id,
                    maxResults=50,
                    pageToken=next_page_token
                ).execute()

                for item in response.get('items', []):
                    video_ids.append(item['contentDetails']['videoId'])

                next_page_token = response.get('nextPageToken')
                if not next_page_token:
                    break

            except HttpError as e:
                logger.error(f"Failed to fetch playlist items: {e}")
                raise

        return video_ids

    def add_video_to_playlist(
        self,
        playlist_id: str,
        video_id: str,
        position: int | None = None
    ) -> dict:
        """Add a video to a playlist.

        Args:
            playlist_id: YouTube playlist ID
            video_id: Video ID to add
            position: Position in playlist (0-based, None = append)

        Returns:
            API response

        Raises:
            HttpError: If API request fails
        """
        logger.info(
            f"Adding video {video_id} to playlist {playlist_id} "
            f"at position {position}"
        )

        try:
            request_body = {
                'snippet': {
                    'playlistId': playlist_id,
                    'resourceId': {
                        'kind': 'youtube#video',
                        'videoId': video_id
                    }
                }
            }

            if position is not None:
                request_body['snippet']['position'] = position

            response = self.youtube.playlistItems().insert(
                part='snippet',
                body=request_body
            ).execute()

            logger.info(f"Video added to playlist successfully")
            return response

        except HttpError as e:
            logger.error(f"Failed to add video to playlist: {e}")
            raise

    def add_video_by_aliyah(
        self,
        parasha_name: str,
        aliyah_name: str,
        video_id: str,
        tradition: str = "Ashkenaz"
    ) -> dict:
        """Add video to parasha playlist at correct aliyah position.

        Args:
            parasha_name: Parasha name
            aliyah_name: Aliyah name (ראשון, שני, etc.)
            video_id: Video ID to add
            tradition: Reading tradition

        Returns:
            API response
        """
        # Get or create playlist
        playlist = self.get_or_create_playlist(parasha_name, tradition)

        # Determine position
        position = playlist.get_aliyah_position(aliyah_name)

        # Add video
        return self.add_video_to_playlist(
            playlist.playlist_id,
            video_id,
            position
        )

    def list_all_playlists(self) -> list[YouTubePlaylist]:
        """List all playlists owned by authenticated user.

        Returns:
            List of playlists
        """
        logger.info("Listing all playlists")

        playlists = []
        next_page_token = None

        while True:
            try:
                response = self.youtube.playlists().list(
                    part='snippet,status,contentDetails',
                    mine=True,
                    maxResults=50,
                    pageToken=next_page_token
                ).execute()

                for item in response.get('items', []):
                    snippet = item['snippet']
                    playlist = YouTubePlaylist(
                        playlist_id=item['id'],
                        parasha_name=snippet.get('title', '').split(' - ')[0],
                        title=snippet['title'],
                        description=snippet.get('description', ''),
                        privacy_status=item['status']['privacyStatus']
                    )
                    playlists.append(playlist)

                next_page_token = response.get('nextPageToken')
                if not next_page_token:
                    break

            except HttpError as e:
                logger.error(f"Failed to list playlists: {e}")
                raise

        logger.info(f"Found {len(playlists)} playlists")
        return playlists
```

### 4.4 Video Updater Service

```python
# src/services/youtube/video_updater.py
# Generated by Claude Code
"""YouTube video content replacement service."""

from pathlib import Path
from googleapiclient.discovery import build
from googleapiclient.http import MediaFileUpload
from googleapiclient.errors import HttpError
import logging

from src.services.youtube.auth import YouTubeAuth
from src.services.youtube.thumbnail_manager import ThumbnailManager
from src.services.youtube.playlist_manager import PlaylistManager
from src.models.video_mapping import VideoMapping
from src.models.youtube_metadata import YouTubeMetadata

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

class VideoUpdater:
    """Updates YouTube video content while preserving thumbnails."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        auth: YouTubeAuth,
        thumbnail_manager: ThumbnailManager,
        playlist_manager: PlaylistManager | None = None
    ):
        """Initialize video updater.

        Args:
            auth: YouTube authentication service
            thumbnail_manager: Thumbnail management service
            playlist_manager: Optional playlist management service
        """
        self.auth = auth
        self.thumbnail_manager = thumbnail_manager
        self.playlist_manager = playlist_manager
        self._youtube = None

    @property
    def youtube(self):
        """Lazy-load YouTube API service."""
        if not self._youtube:
            creds = self.auth.get_credentials()
            self._youtube = build('youtube', 'v3', credentials=creds)
        return self._youtube

    def update_video(
        self,
        mapping: VideoMapping,
        metadata: YouTubeMetadata | None = None
    ) -> dict:
        """Update video content and optionally metadata.

        Note: YouTube API does NOT support replacing video content directly.
        This requires deleting the old video and uploading a new one, then
        restoring the thumbnail.

        Args:
            mapping: Video mapping with old ID and new content
            metadata: Optional updated metadata with CIFRIA attribution

        Returns:
            API response with new video details

        Raises:
            ValueError: If new video file doesn't exist
            HttpError: If API operations fail
        """
        if not mapping.validate_new_video_exists():
            raise ValueError(f"Video file not found: {mapping.new_video_path}")

        logger.info(
            f"Updating video {mapping.youtube_video_id} "
            f"with {mapping.new_video_path}"
        )

        # IMPORTANT: YouTube API doesn't support video replacement
        # We need to:
        # 1. Download original thumbnail
        # 2. Upload new video as replacement
        # 3. Restore thumbnail
        # 4. Update metadata
        # 5. (Optional) Delete old video

        # Step 1: Ensure thumbnail is cached
        cached_thumbnail = self.thumbnail_manager.get_cached_thumbnail(
            mapping.youtube_video_id
        )
        if not cached_thumbnail:
            raise ValueError(
                f"Thumbnail not cached for {mapping.youtube_video_id}. "
                "Run download_thumbnails first."
            )

        # Step 2: Upload new video (creates new video ID)
        new_video_id = self._upload_new_video(
            mapping.new_video_path,
            metadata or self._build_default_metadata(mapping)
        )

        # Step 3: Restore original thumbnail
        if mapping.preserve_thumbnail:
            self._restore_thumbnail(new_video_id, cached_thumbnail)

        # Step 4: Add video to parasha playlist
        playlist_added = False
        if self.playlist_manager:
            try:
                self.playlist_manager.add_video_by_aliyah(
                    parasha_name=mapping.parasha_name,
                    aliyah_name=mapping.aliyah_name,
                    video_id=new_video_id,
                    tradition=mapping.tradition
                )
                playlist_added = True
                logger.info(
                    f"Added video to playlist: {mapping.parasha_name}"
                )
            except Exception as e:
                logger.warning(f"Failed to add video to playlist: {e}")

        logger.info(
            f"Successfully updated video. "
            f"Old ID: {mapping.youtube_video_id}, New ID: {new_video_id}"
        )

        return {
            'old_video_id': mapping.youtube_video_id,
            'new_video_id': new_video_id,
            'thumbnail_restored': mapping.preserve_thumbnail,
            'playlist_added': playlist_added
        }

    def _upload_new_video(
        self,
        video_path: Path,
        metadata: YouTubeMetadata
    ) -> str:
        """Upload new video to YouTube.

        Args:
            video_path: Path to new video file
            metadata: Video metadata

        Returns:
            New video ID

        Raises:
            HttpError: If upload fails
        """
        logger.info(f"Uploading new video: {video_path}")

        body = {
            'snippet': {
                'title': metadata.title,
                'description': metadata.description,
                'tags': metadata.tags,
                'categoryId': metadata.category_id,
                'defaultLanguage': metadata.default_language,
                'defaultAudioLanguage': metadata.default_audio_language,
            },
            'status': {
                'privacyStatus': metadata.privacy_status,
            }
        }

        try:
            media = MediaFileUpload(
                str(video_path),
                mimetype='video/mp4',
                resumable=True,
                chunksize=10 * 1024 * 1024  # 10MB chunks
            )

            request = self.youtube.videos().insert(
                part='snippet,status',
                body=body,
                media_body=media
            )

            response = None
            while response is None:
                status, response = request.next_chunk()
                if status:
                    logger.info(
                        f"Upload progress: {int(status.progress() * 100)}%"
                    )

            video_id = response['id']
            logger.info(f"Video uploaded successfully: {video_id}")
            return video_id

        except HttpError as e:
            logger.error(f"Failed to upload video: {e}")
            raise

    def _restore_thumbnail(self, video_id: str, thumbnail_path: Path) -> None:
        """Restore original thumbnail to new video.

        Args:
            video_id: New video ID
            thumbnail_path: Path to cached thumbnail

        Raises:
            HttpError: If thumbnail upload fails
        """
        logger.info(f"Restoring thumbnail for video: {video_id}")

        try:
            self.youtube.thumbnails().set(
                videoId=video_id,
                media_body=MediaFileUpload(
                    str(thumbnail_path),
                    mimetype='image/jpeg',
                    resumable=True
                )
            ).execute()

            logger.info(f"Thumbnail restored successfully")

        except HttpError as e:
            logger.error(f"Failed to restore thumbnail: {e}")
            raise

    def _build_default_metadata(
        self,
        mapping: VideoMapping
    ) -> YouTubeMetadata:
        """Build default metadata from mapping.

        Args:
            mapping: Video mapping

        Returns:
            Default YouTube metadata
        """
        title = f"{mapping.parasha_name} - {mapping.aliyah_name} | CIFRIA"
        description = f"""
{mapping.parasha_name} - {mapping.aliyah_name} ({mapping.tradition})

Hebrew text synchronized with audio recitation of the Torah portion.

Source materials courtesy of CIFRIA
        """.strip()

        return YouTubeMetadata(
            title=title[:100],  # Truncate if needed
            description=description,
            tags=['Torah', 'Hebrew', 'CIFRIA', mapping.tradition]
        )
```

## 5. Workflow Implementation

### 5.1 Complete Update Workflow

```python
# src/services/youtube/update_workflow.py
# Generated by Claude Code
"""Complete YouTube video update workflow."""

from pathlib import Path
import logging

from src.services.youtube.auth import YouTubeAuth
from src.services.youtube.channel_scanner import ChannelScanner
from src.services.youtube.thumbnail_manager import ThumbnailManager
from src.services.youtube.playlist_manager import PlaylistManager
from src.services.youtube.video_updater import VideoUpdater
from src.models.video_mapping import VideoMapping
from src.models.youtube_metadata import YouTubeMetadata

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

class YouTubeUpdateWorkflow:
    """Orchestrates complete YouTube video update workflow."""

    def __init__(
        self,
        auth: YouTubeAuth,
        thumbnail_cache_dir: Path = Path("data/thumbnails"),
        playlist_cache_dir: Path = Path("data/playlists")
    ):
        """Initialize workflow.

        Args:
            auth: YouTube authentication
            thumbnail_cache_dir: Thumbnail cache directory
            playlist_cache_dir: Playlist cache directory
        """
        self.auth = auth
        self.scanner = ChannelScanner(auth)
        self.thumbnail_manager = ThumbnailManager(thumbnail_cache_dir)
        self.playlist_manager = PlaylistManager(auth, playlist_cache_dir)
        self.updater = VideoUpdater(
            auth,
            self.thumbnail_manager,
            self.playlist_manager
        )

    def prepare_channel(self, channel_handle: str) -> list[str]:
        """Prepare channel by downloading all thumbnails.

        Args:
            channel_handle: YouTube channel handle

        Returns:
            List of video IDs with cached thumbnails
        """
        logger.info(f"Preparing channel: {channel_handle}")

        # Get channel ID
        channel_id = self.scanner.get_channel_id_from_handle(channel_handle)

        # List all videos
        videos = self.scanner.list_all_videos(channel_id)
        logger.info(f"Found {len(videos)} videos")

        # Download all thumbnails
        thumbnail_paths = self.thumbnail_manager.download_all_thumbnails(videos)

        logger.info(
            f"Channel prepared: {len(thumbnail_paths)} thumbnails cached"
        )
        return list(thumbnail_paths.keys())

    def update_single_video(
        self,
        mapping: VideoMapping,
        metadata: YouTubeMetadata | None = None
    ) -> dict:
        """Update a single video.

        Args:
            mapping: Video mapping
            metadata: Optional metadata (otherwise auto-generated)

        Returns:
            Update result with old and new video IDs
        """
        logger.info(f"Updating video: {mapping.youtube_video_id}")

        result = self.updater.update_video(mapping, metadata)

        logger.info(
            f"Video updated: {result['old_video_id']} → {result['new_video_id']}"
        )
        return result

    def update_batch(
        self,
        mappings: list[VideoMapping],
        build_metadata: callable | None = None
    ) -> list[dict]:
        """Update multiple videos in batch.

        Args:
            mappings: List of video mappings
            build_metadata: Optional function to build metadata from mapping

        Returns:
            List of update results
        """
        logger.info(f"Batch updating {len(mappings)} videos")

        results = []
        for i, mapping in enumerate(mappings, 1):
            logger.info(f"Processing video {i}/{len(mappings)}")

            try:
                metadata = None
                if build_metadata:
                    metadata = build_metadata(mapping)

                result = self.update_single_video(mapping, metadata)
                results.append(result)

            except Exception as e:
                logger.error(
                    f"Failed to update {mapping.youtube_video_id}: {e}"
                )
                results.append({
                    'old_video_id': mapping.youtube_video_id,
                    'error': str(e)
                })

        success_count = sum(
            1 for r in results if 'new_video_id' in r
        )
        logger.info(
            f"Batch update complete: {success_count}/{len(mappings)} successful"
        )
        return results
```

```python
# src/cli/youtube_commands.py

"""CLI commands for YouTube video update operations."""

import click
from pathlib import Path
import json
import logging

from src.lib.config import get_config
from src.services.youtube.auth import YouTubeAuth
from src.services.youtube.update_workflow import YouTubeUpdateWorkflow
from src.models.video_mapping import VideoMapping

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

@click.group()
def youtube():
    """YouTube video update and metadata management commands."""
    pass

@youtube.command()
@click.option(
    '--channel',
    default='@קריאהבתורהמפייוסףבודנהיימר',
    help='YouTube channel handle'
)
def prepare_channel(channel: str):
    """Download and cache all thumbnails from source channel.

    Args:
        channel: YouTube channel handle
    """
    config = get_config()

    click.echo(f"Preparing channel: {channel}")

    auth = YouTubeAuth(
        client_secrets_path=Path(config.youtube.client_secrets_path)
    )
    workflow = YouTubeUpdateWorkflow(auth)

    video_ids = workflow.prepare_channel(channel)

    click.echo(f"\n✅ Channel prepared!")
    click.echo(f"   Videos found: {len(video_ids)}")
    click.echo(f"   Thumbnails cached: data/thumbnails/")

@youtube.command()
@click.argument('video_id')
@click.argument('new_video_path', type=click.Path(exists=True))
@click.option('--parasha', required=True, help='Parasha name')
@click.option('--aliyah', required=True, help='Aliyah name')
@click.option('--tradition', default='Ashkenaz', help='Reading tradition')
def update_video(
    video_id: str,
    new_video_path: str,
    parasha: str,
    aliyah: str,
    tradition: str
):
    """Update a single YouTube video with new content.

    Args:
        video_id: Existing YouTube video ID
        new_video_path: Path to new video file
        parasha: Parasha name
        aliyah: Aliyah name
        tradition: Reading tradition
    """
    config = get_config()

    click.echo(f"Updating video: {video_id}")

    # Create mapping
    mapping = VideoMapping(
        youtube_video_id=video_id,
        new_video_path=Path(new_video_path),
        parasha_name=parasha,
        aliyah_name=aliyah,
        tradition=tradition,
        preserve_thumbnail=True
    )

    # Execute update
    auth = YouTubeAuth(
        client_secrets_path=Path(config.youtube.client_secrets_path)
    )
    workflow = YouTubeUpdateWorkflow(auth)

    result = workflow.update_single_video(mapping)

    if 'error' in result:
        click.echo(f"\n❌ Update failed: {result['error']}", err=True)
        raise click.Abort()

    click.echo(f"\n✅ Video updated successfully!")
    click.echo(f"   Old ID: {result['old_video_id']}")
    click.echo(f"   New ID: {result['new_video_id']}")

@youtube.command()
@click.argument('mappings_file', type=click.Path(exists=True))
def batch_update(mappings_file: str):
    """Batch update multiple videos from mapping file.

    Mappings file format (JSON):
    [
        {
            "youtube_video_id": "abc123",
            "new_video_path": "output/video1.mp4",
            "parasha_name": "פרשת בראשית",
            "aliyah_name": "ראשון",
            "tradition": "Ashkenaz"
        },
        ...
    ]

    Args:
        mappings_file: Path to JSON file with video mappings
    """
    config = get_config()

    # Load mappings
    with open(mappings_file) as f:
        mappings_data = json.load(f)

    mappings = [VideoMapping(**m) for m in mappings_data]

    click.echo(f"Batch updating {len(mappings)} videos")

    # Execute batch update
    auth = YouTubeAuth(
        client_secrets_path=Path(config.youtube.client_secrets_path)
    )
    workflow = YouTubeUpdateWorkflow(auth)

    results = workflow.update_batch(mappings)

    # Summary
    success_count = sum(1 for r in results if 'new_video_id' in r)
    failure_count = len(results) - success_count

    click.echo(f"\n✅ Batch update complete!")
    click.echo(f"   Successful: {success_count}")
    click.echo(f"   Failed: {failure_count}")

    if failure_count > 0:
        click.echo("\nFailed videos:")
        for r in results:
            if 'error' in r:
                click.echo(f"   - {r['old_video_id']}: {r['error']}")

@youtube.command()
@click.option(
    '--channel',
    default='@קריאהבתורהמפייוסףבודנהיימר',
    help='YouTube channel handle'
)
@click.option(
    '--output',
    type=click.Path(),
    default='config/video_list.json',
    help='Output file for video list'
)
def list_videos(channel: str, output: str):
    """List all videos from a channel.

    Args:
        channel: YouTube channel handle
        output: Output file path
    """
    config = get_config()

    auth = YouTubeAuth(
        client_secrets_path=Path(config.youtube.client_secrets_path)
    )
    workflow = YouTubeUpdateWorkflow(auth)

    # Get channel videos
    channel_id = workflow.scanner.get_channel_id_from_handle(channel)
    videos = workflow.scanner.list_all_videos(channel_id)

    # Export to JSON
    videos_data = [
        {
            'video_id': v.video_id,
            'title': v.title,
            'published_at': str(v.published_at) if v.published_at else None,
            'thumbnail_url': v.thumbnail_url
        }
        for v in videos
    ]

    output_path = Path(output)
    output_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    with open(output_path, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        json.dump(videos_data, f, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)

    click.echo(f"\n✅ Video list exported!")
    click.echo(f"   Videos found: {len(videos)}")
    click.echo(f"   Output file: {output_path}")

@youtube.command()
@click.argument('parasha_name')
@click.option('--tradition', default='Ashkenaz', help='Reading tradition')
def create_playlist(parasha_name: str, tradition: str):
    """Create a new playlist for a parasha.

    Args:
        parasha_name: Name of parasha (Hebrew)
        tradition: Reading tradition
    """
    config = get_config()

    auth = YouTubeAuth(
        client_secrets_path=Path(config.youtube.client_secrets_path)
    )
    workflow = YouTubeUpdateWorkflow(auth)

    playlist = workflow.playlist_manager.create_playlist(
        parasha_name=parasha_name,
        tradition=tradition
    )

    click.echo(f"\n✅ Playlist created!")
    click.echo(f"   Playlist ID: {playlist.playlist_id}")
    click.echo(f"   Title: {playlist.title}")

@youtube.command()
def list_playlists():
    """List all playlists owned by the authenticated user."""
    config = get_config()

    auth = YouTubeAuth(
        client_secrets_path=Path(config.youtube.client_secrets_path)
    )
    workflow = YouTubeUpdateWorkflow(auth)

    playlists = workflow.playlist_manager.list_all_playlists()

    click.echo(f"\n✅ Found {len(playlists)} playlists:")
    for playlist in playlists:
        status = "✓" if playlist.is_complete() else "○"
        click.echo(
            f"   {status} {playlist.title} "
            f"({len(playlist.video_ids)}/{playlist.aliyah_count} videos)"
        )

@youtube.command()
@click.argument('playlist_id')
@click.argument('video_id')
@click.option('--position', type=int, help='Position in playlist (0-based)')
def add_to_playlist(playlist_id: str, video_id: str, position: int | None):
    """Add a video to a playlist.

    Args:
        playlist_id: YouTube playlist ID
        video_id: Video ID to add
        position: Position in playlist
    """
    config = get_config()

    auth = YouTubeAuth(
        client_secrets_path=Path(config.youtube.client_secrets_path)
    )
    workflow = YouTubeUpdateWorkflow(auth)

    workflow.playlist_manager.add_video_to_playlist(
        playlist_id=playlist_id,
        video_id=video_id,
        position=position
    )

    click.echo(f"\n✅ Video added to playlist!")
    click.echo(f"   Playlist: {playlist_id}")
    click.echo(f"   Video: {video_id}")
    if position is not None:
        click.echo(f"   Position: {position}")
```

### 9.1 Unit Tests

```python
# tests/unit/test_youtube_video.py
# Generated by Claude Code

import pytest
from pathlib import Path
from src.models.youtube_video import YouTubeVideo

def test_youtube_video_creation():
    """Test YouTubeVideo model creation."""
    video = YouTubeVideo(
        video_id="abc123",
        title="Test Video",
        thumbnail_url="https://example.com/thumb.jpg"
    )
    assert video.video_id == "abc123"
    assert not video.has_cached_thumbnail()

def test_youtube_video_cached_thumbnail(tmp_path):
    """Test cached thumbnail detection."""
    thumbnail_path = tmp_path / "thumb.jpg"
    thumbnail_path.write_text("fake thumbnail")

    video = YouTubeVideo(
        video_id="abc123",
        title="Test",
        thumbnail_url="https://example.com/thumb.jpg",
        thumbnail_local_path=thumbnail_path
    )
    assert video.has_cached_thumbnail()
```

## 10. Usage Examples

### 10.1 Step 1: Prepare Channel (One-time)

```bash
# Download and cache all thumbnails from source channel
uv run torah-sync youtube prepare-channel \
  --channel "@קריאהבתורהמפייוסףבודנהיימר"

# Output:
# ✅ Channel prepared!
#    Videos found: 150
#    Thumbnails cached: data/thumbnails/
```

### 10.2 Step 2: List Videos

```bash
# Export list of all videos to JSON
uv run torah-sync youtube list-videos \
  --channel "@קריאהבתורהמפייוסףבודנהיימר" \
  --output config/video_list.json
```

### 10.3 Step 3: Update Single Video

```bash
# Update one video with new content, preserving thumbnail
uv run torah-sync youtube update-video \
  "abc123xyz" \
  output/bereshit-rishon-ashkenaz.mp4 \
  --parasha "פרשת בראשית" \
  --aliyah "ראשון" \
  --tradition Ashkenaz

# Output:
# ✅ Video updated successfully!
#    Old ID: abc123xyz
#    New ID: def456uvw
```

### 10.4 Step 4: Batch Update

```bash
# Create video_mappings.json with all videos to update
# Then run batch update
uv run torah-sync youtube batch-update config/video_mappings.json

# Output:
# ✅ Batch update complete!
#    Successful: 148
#    Failed: 2
```

### 10.5 Playlist Management

```bash
# Create a new playlist for a parasha
uv run torah-sync youtube create-playlist \
  "פרשת בראשית" \
  --tradition Ashkenaz

# Output:
# ✅ Playlist created!
#    Playlist ID: PLxyz123abc
#    Title: פרשת בראשית - Ashkenaz | CIFRIA

# List all your playlists
uv run torah-sync youtube list-playlists

# Output:
# ✅ Found 54 playlists:
#    ✓ פרשת בראשית - Ashkenaz | CIFRIA (7/7 videos)
#    ○ פרשת נח - Ashkenaz | CIFRIA (5/7 videos)
#    ✓ פרשת לך לך - Ashkenaz | CIFRIA (7/7 videos)

# Manually add video to playlist
uv run torah-sync youtube add-to-playlist \
  PLxyz123abc \
  def456uvw \
  --position 0

# Note: Videos are automatically added to playlists during update-video
# or batch-update based on parasha and aliyah information
```

## 11. Important Notes

### 11.1 YouTube API Limitation

**CRITICAL**: YouTube Data API v3 does NOT support replacing video content directly. The workflow must:

1. Download original thumbnail
2. **Upload new video** (creates new video ID)
3. **Add video to parasha playlist** (automatically by aliyah position)
4. Restore thumbnail to new video
5. Update metadata with CIFRIA attribution
6. **(Optional)** Delete old video or redirect

This means video URLs will change. However:
- **Playlists are automatically managed**: Each parasha gets its own playlist with 7 aliyot
- Videos are automatically added to the correct playlist at the right position
- Users can access videos through playlists even if individual URLs change

### 11.2 OAuth2 Setup

Required steps:
1. Create Google Cloud project
2. Enable YouTube Data API v3
3. Create OAuth2 credentials
4. Download `client_secrets.json`
5. Run first command to authorize

### 11.3 API Quotas

YouTube Data API quotas:
- **10,000 units/day** (default free tier)
- Video upload: ~1,600 units
- Thumbnail upload: ~50 units
- Playlist creation: ~50 units
- Add video to playlist: ~50 units
- Daily limit: ~5 video updates (with playlist management)

For larger batches, request quota increase from Google.
